create_sonar_normalizer_from_config: create a SonarNormalizer instance from a SonarNormalizerConfig with optional device and dtype
fit_sonar_normalizer: fit a SonarNormalizer on embeddings to compute center and scale statistics
normalize_sonar_embeddings: normalize SONAR embeddings using a fitted SonarNormalizer with optional FFT and clipping
denormalize_sonar_embeddings: denormalize SONAR embeddings back to original space using a fitted SonarNormalizer
lookup_sonar_normalizer_arch: lookup a registered SONAR normalizer architecture config by name from the config registry
